title: Integral models for constructible continuous E sheaves in degree zero
statement: For prime ℓ and finite normed E/ℚ_ℓ and a scheme X with Noetherian underlying space, let F be a constructible module over the continuous E coefficient ring of [def-weil-pbc-continuous-integral-coefficients]. The single complex F[0] is isomorphic in the ambient E derived category to integralScalarExtension(M), for an integral bounded constructible complex M. This asserts only the degree-zero case, not the result for arbitrary bounded complexes.

source.place: Lemma 6.8.13 and the sheaf case of Proposition 6.8.14(2); uses Lemma 6.8.12 for Ext1 localization

proof.text: On each of finitely many strata, pass from local finite presentations to finite-rank local systems. Choose constructible integral lattices by Lemma 6.8.13. Refine to a finite open--closed filtration, extend the integral models by zero, and lift the successive Ext1 classes after multiplying by powers of ℓ using bounded-below compactness. Such scalars are invertible over E, so the reconstructed integral sheaf rationalizes to F. Exact coefficient localization and the compact-test continuous-function calculation identify the scalar extension of its degree-zero complex with F[0]. The empty scheme and zero module use zero.

theorem continuousConstructible_integral_single_model (X : Scheme.{u})
    [TopologicalSpace.NoetherianSpace X]
    (F : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1})
      (condensedRingObj (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E) X))
    (hF : ProEtale.IsConstructibleModuleObject
      (condensedRingObj (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E) X) F) :
    ∃ M : integralConstructible ℓ E X,
      Nonempty ((integralScalarExtension ℓ E X).obj M.obj ≅
        (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj F)
